review: actual_pending_inherited_response derives the selected actor history and pending source occurrence from the SAME ActorJournal/current raw write call. The current global tick can be a native receive while the engine is still blocked. No future engine return, current write acknowledgement or current kernel effect is required.

Every actual application write is classified through real bootstrap/policy/snapshot/validator/image/VM/publication/retrieval source cuts. File and archive writers derive a genuinely fresh allocated object from their SAME exclusive open; VM cancellation writes are proved unable to use the retained inherited endpoint/OFD. Descriptor number1 alone does not identify a response.

Source-supported open/socket/selfExecutable introductions produce exact old references or genuinely fresh OFD lifetime IDs, including committed error/loss effects. SourceReturnAt derives supported open flags from the selected actual raw occurrence; this is not a no-magic-link object axiom or global numeric inode injectivity.

The final inherited binding requires SAME actual handoff object AND OFD reference. Root/entry native source producers must supply that binding. GatewayPrivateStreams handles real monotone committed extents separately from ACK/error/loss so pending bytes can be received without a future source result and no reply row re-enqueues bytes.
